author: Polar_Express
body:
I would like to submit my new walls maps " Vanilla " for considerations. -------
You can contact me on Skype anytime. Polar_Express_mc
------
Map DL with YML:  https://www.dropbox.com/s/6wu8yuenmsnou39/vanilla.zip?dl=0   , -------
Map Pics :  http://imgur.com/a/B0G7k   ,     --------
-------
About the Map: 
-------
This map was inspired by my good friend Armored Potato. He suggested that we need a map that is more about getting back to the basics. This got me thinking and to that extent I made this map.
-------
Things to know: This map is about keeping it simple and correcting what some people voiced as concerns with both the "Jungle" and "Walls" map, and getting back to PVP without diamonds and golden apples. It also should not be about getting the I-Win middle bow that is Flame, Punch and Power 2... ( don't worry we still have a middle bow, just not an "I win" button bow). Gone are also Strength Potions, God Apples, Fire Res Potions and anything else that would make the playing field uneven from a "basic" perspective. With all of this, I have added " Improved Slowness and Improved Weakness potions. The Slowness will slow you down 45% for 50 sec or less . The Weakness will  dull your attacks by a rating of 2.5 for 50 sec. I have also added multiple Milk buckets to counter this effect. The way the map and middle village is setup should help us take to the trees when needed and have a real PvP adventure, not just bull-doze through the masses with gear. The map also has two short 2 min invisibility potions ( splash ). There are no Enchanting equipment in the quads, so if your after enchants you will need to bring your own or enchant in the village once the walls are down... You will also find a stable ready with saddles and horse armor if your lucky enough to tame your horse after the walls drop. The map only has one magic book in it, and it is a knockback I enchant. Most open world chests have string and arrows, so making a bow should not be that big of a problem, but you will have to make it... no pre-made bows are on the map, bar the center chest, so bring your own or make one... it is possible to make a bow in your starting quad before the walls drop, but you will have to find and chop down spider webs for string.  Kits were taken into account when I made the map. Apples and cookies can be found in chests for those that use those kits, Water buckets, Lava buckets and empty buckets can also be found. Almost any kit choose will be of much more use on this map that any other. Poseidon will also be a good kit as you regenerate in water - and since no one is going to hit you with an enchanted diamond sword, you will be able to take more hits - especially if you hit them with a weakness potion first. Enchanter will be a very strong kit on this map, so pick your kits wisely. I would also think this map would be a good place to use Archer, Barbarian, Guardian,  and Cowboy, but  no matter what the kit, if you hit them with 50 sec of slowness and pull out your bow, your going to have a chance as even normal arrows hurt iron.... but I'm sure you will find a way to enchant the bow... I think that would be my first enchant on this map. Also, as a side note, This map is built very high in the grid, so 30 blocks above the tallest tree will be build height... so say goodbye to the 100 block high sky-base. 30 blocks can be reached easily by any bow, and built to without problem. This map also has about 64 TNT with all the needed material to ignite... I cant wait to see 7-8 players get destroyed because someone wants to tunnel under mid and blow it up.... the middle allows about 6 blocks deep to be dug before bedrock... so if  that's your thing....
-------
Each quad is the normal walls quad size, so no changes in that respect. Each quad has only 1 chest. I hope we don't get people that want to break the chest... but I cant control that. In the chest are some arrows ( 32), and  (4), stone pick axes and (1) shear.
-------
Each Quad has two Mine entrances and both are labeled with signs and decorations , very easy to find. The mines are very direct and finding ore should not be a problem for new players. I would expect that everyone that wants to take to the ground in full iron would be able to do so, but building up any farther than that, will not be possible, unless your kit provides it. Everything matters on this map, so I hope we get to play it. I know that some players will not like the fact that it is a lower level map, that it is more about using your environment and skill, and not using diamonds , potions, and what have you. We have plenty of Gear Heavy, Potion Heavy, Item Heavy, maps...  This one is about being tactical - IMO.

-----
Thanks for Reading, I will only respond to Map Devs and Mods Remarks - give it  a +1 if you want to give it a try.

________



.

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
The sand walls in the "walls " are just for looks. The Plugin will stop people from crossing. Normal walls are 20 blocks high, these are 15 ( in most places). If people want to build up and shoot people over them, it can be done just as easily on the 20 block high walls.

Shooting people pre-walls drop is ban-able if i remember correctly, so i didn't build the walls to a specific prevention  height other than to make it something they would have to do the act on purpose. Also there is a 40 block Gap between Quads so it would have to be a pretty good shot :)
